answer: THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Patient [is of Laboratory has LaboratoryCRP: '+'] BUT NOT has PatientDescription
THE COUNT OF Examination [has ExaminationThrombosis: 2] [has ExaminationANAPattern: 'S'] [has ExaminationACLIgM m] WHERE m > 1.2 * THE AVERAGE Examination has ExaminationACLIgM
THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Patient [is of Laboratory has LaboratorySM s WHERE s = 'negative' OR s = '0'] [is of Examination has ExaminationThrombosis: 0]
LIST id, sex, dx FROM DISTINCT Patient [is of Examination has ExaminationThrombosis: 2] has PatientID id AND ALSO has PatientSEX sex AND ALSO has PatientDiagnosis dx
THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Patient [has PatientSEX: 'F'] [has PatientDescription d WHERE year(d) = 1997] [has PatientAdmission: '-']
THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Patient [has PatientSEX: 'F'] [is of Examination [has ExaminationThrombosis: 1] has ExaminationDate d WHERE year(d) = 1997]
LIST m FROM Patient [has PatientDiagnosis: 'SLE'] [has PatientDescription: '1994-02-19'] is of Examination [has ExaminationDate: '1993-11-12'] has ExaminationACLIgM m
LIST id FROM DISTINCT Patient [has PatientAdmission: '-'] [is of Laboratory [has LaboratoryDate d WHERE like(d, '1991-10%')] has LaboratoryTBIL b WHERE b < 2.0] has PatientID id

LIST id, sex, age FROM DISTINCT Patient [is of Laboratory [has LaboratoryGLU g WHERE g >= 180] has LaboratoryTCHO t WHERE t < 250] has PatientID id AND ALSO has PatientSEX sex AND ALSO has PatientBirthday b AND ALSO (year(today()) - year(b)) AS age

LIST id FROM DISTINCT Patient [is of Laboratory [has LaboratoryDate d WHERE d >= '1987-07-06' AND d <= '1996-01-31'] [has LaboratoryGPT g WHERE g > 30] has LaboratoryALB a WHERE a < 4] has PatientID id ORDERED WITH id ASCENDING
